steps.speaker: Vague Voice
steps.content: Zoya...
The voice sounds so familiar...

steps.speaker: Vague Voice
steps.content: Wake up... Zoya... Wake up...
Who's calling for me?

steps.speaker: Vague Voice
steps.content: Get up!
The jolt beneath her body startles the sleep out of her entirely. The familiar charm hangs from the rear-view mirror, swaying back and forth, left and right.
The desolate desert, the rusty iron towers, and the familiar passenger seat... everything in sight somehow makes her feel very nostalgic.

steps.speaker: Leggett
steps.content: What were you dreaming about? You were shouting and cursing, even throwing punches. You almost slapped my face. Did you do that on purpose?
Of course this is a dream. Leggett used to drive her around like this all the time, saying he was going on patrol. But that was so many years ago.

steps.speaker: Zoya
steps.content: Haha... I had a weird dream. I dreamed of you.

steps.speaker: Leggett
steps.content: Oh?

steps.speaker: Zoya
steps.content: I dreamed of you talking to me gently. It was kinda gross.
He knocks Zoya's head hard. It actually hurts as she remembers.

steps.speaker: Leggett
steps.content: Are you awake now? Hell, haven't I always been f***ing gentle with you? Aren't I always there every time you get yourself in trouble?
Is this not a dream? That's nice... But it's probably not real either.
Is this the afterworld? Or just a lingering vision?

In the rear-view mirror, a cloud of obscure mass is sitting in the back seat. It forms a human shape occasionally and disperses again, peeking forward with a twisted obsession while mumbling something unintelligible.
Further back, behind the rear window, the desolate road is being swallowed by a sandstorm and is constantly collapsing. The sandstorm is roaring, chasing the only vehicle in this world.

Someone refuses to spare her, so even this small world is going to be destroyed by that darkness sooner or later. But if this is the last moment of peace, then... she doesn't wish to be disturbed now.

steps.speaker: Leggett
steps.content: You're a grown-up now and you still let your old man drive. Every time I buy you a new car, you crash it right away.

steps.speaker: Leggett
steps.content: Hell, I was once the head of Nirvana's fleet back in the day. How have I raised such a vehicle butcher like you? What a shame.

steps.speaker: Zoya
steps.content: Quit nagging. I know all the guys in that fleet of yours very well. They dare not think I'm disgracing them.

steps.speaker: Leggett
steps.content: Huh? You've met them?

steps.speaker: Zoya
steps.content: I have. I'm their boss now. We've got a cool new name and dealt with all the other gangs. I've even heard many of the foolish deeds you did when you were young.

steps.speaker: Zoya
steps.content: You geezer were so patriotic back then, you became a sheriff in order to save Syndicate, huh?

steps.speaker: Leggett
steps.content: Ahem... ahem! You little punk! How dare you get my brothers into this shady business too?

steps.speaker: Leggett
steps.content: Haven't I told you before? Stop throwing punches every time you encounter a problem! Think of other ways, don't rely on violence like those stinky gangs!

steps.speaker: Zoya
steps.content: Haha, can't help it. I'm no better than a violent Syndican.

steps.speaker: Zoya
steps.content: Geezer, many things have happened since you left. They've made me realize this is who I am.

steps.speaker: Zoya
steps.content: I'm not as capable as you said I was gonna be. I can't imagine a good version of Syndicate, and I can't create any future. All I have in me is violence, and all I do is destroy.

steps.speaker: Leggett
steps.content: ...Is this your answer? That's the best way you can fight?

steps.speaker: Zoya
steps.content: Yeah. I can't do it, but there's someone who can.

steps.speaker: Zoya
steps.content: They have people they cherish and a future they look forward to. They see the good side of Syndicate which is imperceptible to me.

steps.speaker: Zoya
steps.content: Those people are Syndicate's true hope.

steps.speaker: Zoya
steps.content: What I have to do is open up a path for them using my violence. Defeat all the decadence blocking the way and clean up this place before handing it to them.

steps.speaker: Leggett
steps.content: ...Then what about yourself?

steps.speaker: Zoya
steps.content: I'm part of the decadence too, a thug raised in the darkest days of Syndicate. If there is a bright future, I shouldn't belong there.

steps.speaker: Zoya
steps.content: I've done everything I could. I've crushed the darkness before me, and I've opened up the path.

steps.speaker: Zoya
steps.content: Now, I've turned into one of their obstacles. This has to end.
The obscure mass behind lets out a murky and suppressed whisper, but Zoya doesn't look back.
She has understood that the only real enemy left now is herself. It's the darkness that her heart could not part with that led to the abyss.
And this darkness is her roots, her power, and where she truly belongs.

steps.speaker: Zoya
steps.content: Soon... I'll fight the last battle. I hope you can witness it. And take me with you afterwards.

steps.speaker: Zoya
steps.content: I'm glad you've come...
Leggett looks ahead and says nothing. After a long while, he begins again.

steps.speaker: Leggett
steps.content: You've found people you can count on... Seems like after I left, some good things have happened to you after all. You've met some decent people, haven't you?

steps.speaker: It's not even a complicated case, yet it was handled like this...
steps.content: ...Yeah. Quite a few, in fact.
A brainy one, a passionate one, and many others who've joined the Legion with their visions. They long for a future for Syndicate, and they're capable of creating one.

steps.speaker: Leggett
steps.content: I'm relieved to hear that...

steps.speaker: Leggett
steps.content: I didn't come... to take you away... Zoya. Your fight... is not finished yet...

steps.speaker: Zoya
steps.content: Leggett?
His figure is starting to blur. Is he leaving? Zoya grabs his hand urgently.
The driver is still there. But when his face becomes clear again, it belongs to another person.

steps.speaker: Earl
steps.content: Don't even put your hand within half a meter of the steering wheel. You wanna blow up this car too?

steps.speaker: Zoya
steps.content: ...Why are you here?

steps.speaker: Earl
steps.content: I need to get Commander out of here.

steps.speaker: Zoya
steps.content: What? Stop nagging! I told you, this is my own fight.

steps.speaker: Earl
steps.content: You're the Legion's commander. Your fight is the Legion's fight.
A brief silence. There's only suppressed murmur stirring somewhere in the car.

steps.speaker: Zoya
steps.content: ...Do you still remember our promise when the Legion was first founded?

steps.speaker: Zoya
steps.content: I'll give you power, and you'll give me information. I need to wreck everything of the past, and you need a brand new future.

steps.speaker: Zoya
steps.content: The promise has been realized. That corrupt Syndicate is in ruins now, and my fight will soon be over. It'll be your turn next. Don't you want to build a Syndicate that can bring happiness to your sister?

steps.speaker: Zoya
steps.content: The Legion is no longer needed, Earl. Let everyone return to the fleet. Even if I'm not there, you guys can keep on fighting.

steps.speaker: Earl
steps.content: ...Don't be a fool. People like you, you know nothing at all.

steps.speaker: Earl
steps.content: The fights of ordinary people are forever accompanied by cowardice, regrets, and numbness. No matter what beautiful vision you have, no matter how much you want to persevere, those who are scared of failure and loss will still escape from the battleground again and again.

steps.speaker: Earl
steps.content: Only you can always be so asserted and fearless. Not everyone is as strong as you are.

steps.speaker: Earl
steps.content: It's exactly because you're here, we can get back on our feet time after time. After meeting you, I finally began to believe it was worth it to keep fighting in Syndicate.

steps.speaker: Earl
steps.content: There's no end to the darkness. Syndicate needs you, and the Legion needs you. If the only thing you can do is fight, then never stop fighting. I won't let you run away.

steps.speaker: Zoya
steps.content: Wow, you're jinxing me or something?

steps.speaker: Earl
steps.content: I am. You've sent so many people to battles, don't think you can get out of this so easily.

steps.speaker: Zoya
steps.content: ...Hmm, hahahaha! So this is still about Horo, isn't it?

steps.speaker: Zoya
steps.content: Get over it, you doting brother. I never provoked her. You know full well that Horo was born a warrior, and she went to battles only for you.

steps.speaker: Earl
steps.content: ...Humph.

steps.speaker: Zoya
steps.content: But you've indeed reminded me... If I'm gonna fight anyway, it's much more fun to do it with you guys than being stuck here.

steps.speaker: Zoya
steps.content: Drive, I'll go back with you. You know the way, don't you?
As if sensing the changes in her mood, the faraway sandstorm blasts out a deafening howl, whirling and chasing after them, crushing this world hysterically.
Inside the car, Earl only smiles.

steps.speaker: Earl
steps.content: I do. But I won't be the person bringing you back...
In the blink of an eye, Zoya suddenly finds herself gripping the steering wheel in the driver's seat.

Earl is gone. His voice is fading away, coming from behind. Zoya turns back instantly, but she sees that he's already outside the car, standing in the middle of the road, smiling and watching her. Behind him is the howling limbo, the world that's falling apart.

steps.speaker: Earl
steps.content: I'll stop it. Go, Zoya. You're the beacon. Go and lead all those who yearn to fight to the battleground.

steps.speaker: Earl
steps.content: If you still feel lost, then go and find... <color=#fb9259>the one who can guide you</color>...

The car doesn't stop and keeps shooting forward, leaving him dwindling behind. The black sandstorm is swarming near and roaring, but it's blocked by Earl. His figure is completely swallowed by the sandstorm.

steps.speaker: Earl
steps.content: Take care of... Horo...

steps.speaker: Zoya
steps.content: Earl?!
Don't stop!
The mist in the back seat wriggles and blocks her sight. A voice comes from the limbo.
That's his fight. Your battleground is ahead of you, keep going forward!

steps.speaker: Zoya
steps.content: Who are you really?!
The red brand emerges on Zoya's right hand, the burning pain stimulating her soul sharply.

steps.speaker: Zoya
steps.content: ...It's you?
It's an extraordinarily persistent will, dispelling the twisted mist, breaking free from the clingy shadows, and finally reaching her side.

options: Come back, Zoya, I need you

steps.content: This is your Black Ring. Make it obey your will.
His words were firm and unquestionable, an absolute will to fight, pulling Zoya back to reality, back to her true self.
steps.female_content: Her words were firm and unquestionable, an absolute will to fight, pulling Zoya back to reality, back to her true self.

steps.speaker: Corpseborne
steps.content: Aaahhh...!!

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: What happened? Why is the monster suddenly jumping?! And it looks like it's in pain too?

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: This is not caused by external attacks. Someone has dissolved the Ring's will from the inside. The Black Ring's laws have been shaken!

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: Could it be... Chief, did you do it?
The shackles on your hands are burning, but you don't feel any pain, only infinite power.

Someone is crying out and roaring inside the Corpseborne. She is breaking free from the swamp that entangles her, and crushing the darkness from within. All her anguish, her urge and her determination are unflinchingly conveyed to you.
She's defeated herself, and she's defeated the Black Ring.
Now, it's our turn.
